summary: AngloGold Ashanti plc filed a Form 6-K with the SEC, furnishing an investor presentation for its Q1 2026 (half-year) earnings release. The filing is a routine earnings-related disclosure by a foreign private issuer, containing no M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation content. It includes the earnings release and investor presentation as exhibits, signed by the company secretary. No deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic actions are described. This is a standard periodic report, not a special situation.
